scope: Local release-binary service correctness, cold-wake regression controls, and one baseline/final small-data recovery event each.
limitations: One host, loopback TCP/HTTP/mTLS and ephemeral local disk; no AZ fault or production placement validation.
Four scheduled measurement requests per second across two databases, not the 500 requests/second reference load.
Each build has one leader-loss measurement; these are observations, not an RTO percentile or causal single-change performance study.
Latency percentiles describe successful samples. Every planned failure, UNKNOWN and rejection remains in its original denominator.
The native backend is the same pinned O3 archive. Rust release linking uses an explicit C++ runtime flag on the final prebuilt-native path.
Full private fixture logs, generated credentials and configuration are excluded; the public raw-artifact index retains immutable hashes.

build_identity.source_manifest_method: Sorted repository-relative path and SHA256 records; aggregate SHA256 over UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys and compact separators. Includes root/crate Cargo files, lockfile, toolchain, Rust/proto production compilation files, and SDK source/package/tsconfig inputs; separate test files are excluded.

environment.topology: one host, loopback HTTP and mTLS TCP, three real daemons, ephemeral local disk

timestamp_validation.note: The unchanged one-second measurement timer can fire slightly before its planned timestamp; original timestamps and planned-time latency remain unmodified.

recovery.limitations: One small-data loopback event; four probes/s, not the 500 requests/s reference load. No AZ failures, no latency-SLO or percentile-RTO claim. Build profile and exact binary hash are recorded; failures and UNKNOWN remain in the sample denominator.

s3_backend.transport: explicit loopback TCP between component processes

preserved_failed_attempts.reason: Pinned SeaweedFS mini cannot create its Unix gRPC socket in this executor; authenticated S3 startup did not finish. No service contract started.
preserved_failed_attempts.resolution: Use the same pinned backend's supported independent TCP master/volume/filer/s3 processes; do not modify permissions or upstream source.

preserved_failed_attempts.reason: Original shared SQL owner blocks alpha behind the blackholed cold beta wake; three of four alpha probes fail and beta has no per-database admission rejection.
All foreground isolation probes and quota checks passed, but the following fresh cold-status request returned NO_LEADER; the lifecycle contract did not complete.
preserved_failed_attempts.diagnosis: Source review found that deadline failures in a database worker could clear node-wide readiness shared by other databases; compiler and memory pressure were also present, so the sample is not an idle latency comparison.

preserved_failed_attempts.reason: Contract01 completed; contract02 had one SDK test pass and four OVERLOADED failures following sequential calls. Contracts03 through08 were not reached.
preserved_failed_attempts.diagnosis: An empty SQL lane could still be retiring when a subsequent request arrived; the dispatcher rejected the request instead of handing it to the replacement bounded lane.

resolved_build_failures.reason: The libclang wheel lacked builtin C headers, so RocksDB bindgen failed on stdbool.h.
resolved_build_failures.resolution: Point bindgen at the installed GCC13 builtin include directory; do not change RocksDB or libSQL source.

resolved_build_failures.reason: The in-flight first-party dependency edit required its lockfile update and the locked build refused to proceed.
resolved_build_failures.resolution: Update all workspace/experiment lockfiles to the already pinned dependency version, then keep --locked on subsequent builds.

resolved_build_failures.reason: A shared baseline/current target retained stale wire metadata during live edits, so runtime could not see the new authorize_peer method.
resolved_build_failures.resolution: Retain the reviewed authorization contract; rebuild current sources in an isolated release target.

resolved_build_failures.reason: Cleaning first-party artifacts in the shared worktree target still left incompatible metadata references and missing rlib-form dependencies.
resolved_build_failures.resolution: Build the complete changed Rust dependency graph in a dedicated target while reusing only the exact pinned O3 RocksDB archive through its supported static-link environment variables.
